reply.text:
This one needs care. "Injury-proofing" is a goal I can't promise, and I won't assess your knees. If they have been bothering you, that is one for a doctor or physio, and I'll train around whatever they clear.

What I can do is build you a strong, well-rounded lower-body block ahead of ski season: single-leg work, hamstrings, glutes, and controlled landing practice, with no guarantees on the outcome. Tell me how many days a week you can train, how long you have, and where you train, and I'll set it up.
